_recipe: Produced by scripts/close-season.mjs when a season ends — don't hand-edit this shape from scratch. COPY THIS FILE to <season>.json only as a starting point for a season that predates the close-season script (e.g. migrated Squarespace history). One mvp tile per gameweek that season; its slides[] are that week's real tiles (same shapes as content/gameweeks/gameweek.template.json). Delete every _comment/_recipe key when done.

tiles._comment: One of these per gameweek that season, oldest→newest. cover = that week's podcast YouTube thumbnail (stand-in photography, no player-imagery rights).

slides._comment: That week's original tiles, unchanged — copied verbatim from its old gw-01.json before archiving it.
